## Question 1: Differentiation [1]{.difficulty}

Differentiate the following functions with respect to $x$.

(a) $f(x) = x^3 - 2x + 1$.

(b) $g(x) = \sin(x^2)$.

(c) $h(x) = x \, \mathrm{e}^{-x}$.

## Question 2: Integration [2]{.difficulty}

Evaluate the following integrals.

(a) $\displaystyle \int_0^1 (3x^2 + 1) \, \mathrm{d}x$.

(b) $\displaystyle \int x \cos x \, \mathrm{d}x$.

    _Hint: use integration by parts._

## Question 3: A limit [3]{.difficulty}

Show that
$$
\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{1 - \cos x}{x^2} = \frac{1}{2}.
$$
